channel.title: Detroit Sports Nation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: Report: Detroit Lions Executive Was Also Interviewing for GM Position
item.description: According to a report from ESPN’s Dianna Russini, Detroit Lions executive Mike Disner’s recent interview with the Atlanta Falcons involved more than just their opening for team president. Russini revealed that the Falcons interviewed Disner along with Bears assistant GM…

item.title: Detroit Lions Up-and-Coming Assistant Completes Interview With Buccaneers
item.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers have interviewed Detroit Lions assistant Jett Modkins as they begin their search for a new special teams coordinator, highlighting the growing demand for Detroit’s coaching staff.

item.title: Detroit Lions Fans Assign Grade to Dan Campbell Following 2025 Season
item.description: Detroit Lions fans gave head coach Dan Campbell a “C” grade after the team fell from 15-2 in 2024 to 9-8 and missed the playoffs in 2025, according to an SB Nation poll.

item.title: Detroit Lions Coach Emerges as Serious Candidate in Buccaneers’ OC Search
item.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers have interviewed Detroit Lions passing game coordinator David Shaw for their offensive coordinator opening, putting another key member of Dan Campbell’s staff in the 2026 coaching carousel spotlight.

item.title: Detroit Tigers Interested In 2 Free Agent Pitchers, Tarik Skubal Arbitration Ruling Could Change That
item.description: The Detroit Tigers are exploring free-agent pitchers Lucas Giolito and Chris Bassitt, but Tarik Skubal’s arbitration ruling could impact their offseason spending and rotation plans.

item.title: Detroit Lions LB Jack Campbell Fined By NFL
item.description: Detroit Lions linebacker Jack Campbell was fined $17,389 for a hip-drop tackle in the Week 18 win over the Bears, with the fine announced the same day he was named AP First Team All-Pro.

item.title: Report: University of Michigan Closing In on New President With Strong Sports Pedigree
item.description: The University of Michigan is expected to announce its next president this week, with reports indicating the hire comes from a school with major athletic success. Vincent Price and Julio Frenk rumored as possible candidates.

item.title: Former Michigan Tight End Brady Prieskorn Announces Transfer Destination
item.description: Former Michigan tight end Brady Prieskorn has committed to Ole Miss after appearing in three games for the Wolverines in 2025.

item.title: WILD SCENE! Youth Hockey Game Explodes Into Chaos During Hershey Bears Intermission
item.description: A youth hockey exhibition during the Hershey Bears vs. Cleveland Monsters intermission turned into chaos when an all-out brawl broke out — including one player accidentally punching a teammate.

item.title: Alex Bregman Finds New Home, Signs MEGA Contract
item.description: Alex Bregman is headed to the Chicago Cubs for the 2026 season, ending Detroit Tigers fans’ hopes of landing the star infielder.
